resources.string: Fang Harness\'s Wolfi OS runtime isn\'t ready. Open setup to install it.

Node.js is missing in Wolfi OS. Open setup to repair the runtime.

Termux is not installed. Install it from F-Droid or Google Play.
For your security, Fang only runs in the official F-Droid or Google Play build of Termux, and the Termux on this phone is neither. Reinstall Termux from F-Droid or Google Play.
Termux blocked Fang\'s commands. Run the setup command in Termux, then retry.
Android blocked starting Termux in the background. Open Fang and retry.
Open Termux once and let it finish installing.
Termux stopped while starting Fang\'s helper. Retry.
Termux couldn\'t run Fang\'s helper. Retry.
Termux was reinstalled, which removed Pi, its sign-in and Fang\'s setup in Termux. Run the setup command in Termux again.
Fang isn\'t set up in Termux yet. Run the setup command in Termux.

Fang\'s helper isn\'t running in Termux. Open Termux, then switch back to Fang.
